desc:
Protect your bed. Break theirs. Be the last team standing!

👍 Like the game and join our Group for a free class, Coins and Gems!
  NEW CODES AT 1000 LIKES!

Classic 1.8-style Bed Wars with the combat you remember: sprint hits, block-ins, bridging, fireballs and TNT.

⚔️ MODES
 Solos, Doubles and Squads
 Vote for the map before every match

🗺️ 7 MAPS
 Islands, Treenan, Hatchery, Glacier, Ember, Citadel and Skyline

🛏️ HOW TO PLAY
 Collect iron and gold at your base, diamonds and emeralds on the islands
 Buy blocks, weapons, armor and tools from the Item Shop
 Upgrade your team and set traps
 Break enemy beds so they can't respawn, then finish them off

🎒 MAKE IT YOURS
 Classes with their own gear and abilities
 Capes, emotes, gadgets and win celebrations from Crates

👥 PLAY TOGETHER
 Party up with friends and queue as a team
 Works on PC, mobile and controller

⚠️ This game is not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft. All game assets are original and independently created.
